name: stash-bot
_note: Stash is a UCI engine; perft is routed through `go perft N` and uses movelist_size as a depth-1 bulk count. Build with NATIVE=yes for movegen speed (per upstream guidance — the default Makefile may pick a sub-optimal arch flag set otherwise). The launch is prefixed with `stdbuf -oL` because Stash doesn't fflush stdout after the perft `info nodes …` line; without line-buffering the runner times out waiting for output.
